'''Annis''' is an [[NPC]] that appears in {{Quest|A Fleeting Night's Dream}}.

Annis was a hallucination conjured by Cantarella to cope with the horrors of the Divine Trials. The backstory that Cantarella created for Annis was that despite not being of the Fisalia bloodline, Annis took part in the Divine Trials during which she, alongside Cantarella, made it past the second trial. At some point during the trials, she lost her voice permanently due to exposure to various poisons.
